fieldCheckMethod: Parse the rule's detection section, take every key of each selection (ignoring 'condition'), strip any modifiers after the first '|', and compare that set of field names with the set used by the valid reference rule: it passes only if nothing is missing and nothing is unexpected.
threatDescription: Attackers run certutil.exe with -urlcache to download a payload from a remote URL.

variants.label: Valid rule
variants.yaml:
title: Certutil Used to Download a File
id: 5f3c7a1e-2b8d-4c61-9e0a-7d4b1f2e6a90
status: experimental
description: Detects certutil.exe run with the urlcache flag and a URL, a common way to download a payload with a built-in Windows tool.
author: Pushkar Singh (example rule for portfolio)
date: 2026-09-11
tags:
    - attack.command-and-control
    - attack.t1105
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    selection_cli:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'urlcache'
            - 'http'
    condition: selection_img and selection_cli
falsepositives:
    - Administrators downloading files with certutil
level: high
